protocol.objective: Remove minority-background foreground bias and inverse-baking artifacts with geometry-consistent semantic masks, UV background fusion, and explicit spatial prior.

methods.uv_fusion: Median of non-vehicle training observations in UV; harmonic interpolation only where count=0; resolve through common 512 basis; no optimizer.
methods.geo_mask: Original mean initialization and baking, replacing per-oblique-view detections with projected source-epoch masks.
methods.geo_fusion: geo_mask with UV fusion initialization; otherwise original baking.
methods.geo_smooth: geo_fusion plus confidence-weighted anisotropic TV and anchor on no-observation initialization.

protocol.harmonic_kernel: four-neighbor Laplace average; observed texels fixed
protocol.selection: Fixed a priori from training coverage and known numerical failures; no 2026 pixels/annotation used in fusion, optimization, or hyperparameter selection.
protocol.evaluation: Reuse frozen 33 full OBB footprints, 21 majority-occluded footprints and 2026 actual observed background; identical metrics to previous harder_dataset experiment.
